t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are 8 gnomes of different colours and 2 colour baskets. Each of the gnomes has a coloured hat to tell which basket to pick.

vb_textbox.text: This experiment contains 8 different coloured gnomes, red, brown, pink and purple, selecting one of these colours will lead you to a red baskets or blue, orange, green and yellow which will lead you to a yellow basket. Try to make a note of which colour basket gives you the most mushrooms and select this colour on a 5X multiplier. The best basket colour changes over time so please keep checking on the 1x multiplier that you are still selecting the best colour basket that will earn you the most amount of mushrooms.
